calculators.name: Additive - Parts per build
calculators.description: How many parts one build takes: the part's footprint on the plate, with the nesting allowance (nestingAllowance) on each side, laid in rows on the machine's bed, the better of the two ways round; a powder bed that needs no plate supports (SLS) also stacks them in height above its base layers. Capped by the batch.

source.engine: build_height_mm (the part's height plus its support base)
stacks (1 for a laser sintered build, which needs no plate, else 0)
base_height_mm (slsBaseLayersHeight for a laser sintered build, else 0)

fields.name: Parts per Layer
fields.formula: max(floor({Bed Length} / ({Part Length} + 2 * {Nesting Allowance})) * floor({Bed Width} / ({Part Width} + 2 * {Nesting Allowance})), floor({Bed Length} / ({Part Width} + 2 * {Nesting Allowance})) * floor({Bed Width} / ({Part Length} + 2 * {Nesting Allowance})))

fields.name: Parts Stacked
fields.formula: {Stacks} > 0 ? max(1, floor(({Bed Height} - {Base Height}) / ({Build Height} + 2 * {Nesting Allowance}))) : 1

fields.name: Parts per Build
fields.formula: max(1, min({Batch Size}, {Parts per Layer} * {Parts Stacked}))

calculators.name: Additive - Melt complexity
calculators.description: The scan time adjustment of a laser melted part by its melting modulus, surface area over volume: below lowMeltingModulus a compact part scans faster (lowComplexityAdjustment), above highMeltingModulus a thin-walled one slower (highComplexityAdjustment).

fields.name: Complexity Factor
fields.formula: {Melting Modulus} < {Low Modulus} ? {Low Adjustment} : {Melting Modulus} > {High Modulus} ? {High Adjustment} : 1

calculators.name: Additive - Metal powder
calculators.description: The metal powder one part takes: the part and its supports (as a lattice, dmlsLatticeSpacingFactor of the support volume), plus the powder lost to the process (dmlsPowderLossToProcessInefficiency of that volume) and the powder trapped in the supports (dmlsPowderTrappedInSupportStructures of the support volume), at the material's density and price.

source.engine: support_volume_mm3 (the overhang supports and the support base)

calculators.name: Additive - Polymer powder
calculators.description: The polymer powder one laser sintered part takes: the part itself, and its share of the bed's powder that cannot be used again. The bed (its area times the build's height, at the powder's tapped density) is spent at the share not recycled (1 - the material's recycle percentage) and, of what is recycled, once every Max Powder Cycles builds.

source.engine: bed_fill_height_mm (the build's stacked height and base layers)
parts_per_build

fields.name: Spent Powder Mass
fields.formula: {Bed Powder Mass} * ((1 - {Recycle Fraction}) + {Recycle Fraction} / max({Max Powder Cycles}, 1)) / max({Parts per Build}, 1)

calculators.name: Additive - Resin and support material
calculators.description: The material one printed or stereolithography part takes: the part at its density and price, and its supports. Material jetting prints them in a support material of its own (printingSupportMaterialDensity, printingSupportMaterialCost; as solid as printingLatticeSpacingFactor); stereolithography builds them of the part's resin, as solid as slaSupportVolumeFraction.

source.engine: support_volume_mm3
support_fill (printingLatticeSpacingFactor when printing, slaSupportVolumeFraction for stereolithography)
support_density (printingSupportMaterialDensity when printing, the resin's density for stereolithography)
support_unit_cost (printingSupportMaterialCost when printing, the resin's price for stereolithography)

calculators.name: Additive - Build gas
calculators.description: The nitrogen a laser sintering or melting build consumes, at the machine's rate over the build's time, shared by its parts (the machine's nitrogen cost per litre; a machine without one makes its own and pays nothing here).

source.engine: build_time_s (the sintering step's Build Time)
parts_per_build

fields.name: Gas Cost
fields.formula: {Nitrogen Rate} * {Build Time} / 3600 * {Nitrogen Cost} / max({Parts per Build}, 1)

calculators.name: Additive - Metal sintering
calculators.description: Laser melting on a metal powder bed (DMLS / SLM), per part. The build: every layer is recoated (the blade over the bed at dmlsPowderRecoatSpeedOver and back at dmlsPowderRecoatSpeedReturn) and waits the machine's layer delay; the part and its lattice supports are scanned at the machine's speed, beam and lasers, adjusted for the part's melt complexity. The build's fixed steps (heat the chamber, purge it, fit the plate, load the file, cool down) are shared by its parts. The part stands on a support base (baseSupportHeightPowerRemoval) that is cut away after.

source.engine: layer_thickness_mm (the machine's minimum, not below tblLayerThickness)
melted_volume_mm3 (Additive - Metal powder)
complexity_factor (Additive - Melt complexity)
parts_per_build (Additive - Parts per build)

fields.name: Recoat Time
fields.formula: {Bed Length} / {Recoat Speed Over} + {Bed Length} / {Recoat Speed Return} + {Layer Delay}

fields.name: Scan Time
fields.formula: {Melted Volume} / ({Scanning Speed} * {Beam Diameter} * {Layer Thickness} * max({Lasers}, 1)) * {Complexity Factor}

fields.name: Build Setup
fields.formula: {Heat Time} + {Purge Time} + {Fit Plate Time} + {Load File Time} * 3600 + {Cool Time}

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: ({Build Time} + {Build Setup}) / {Parts per Build} * {Cycle Time Factor}

calculators.name: Additive - Laser sintering
calculators.description: Laser sintering on a polymer powder bed (SLS), per part. The parts need no supports and are stacked in the bed: the build is as tall as the stack above its base layers (slsBaseLayersHeight), every layer at slsLayerThickness waits the machine's layer delay (the recoat), and each part is scanned at the machine's speed and beam. The build's fixed steps (prepare and heat the chamber, fit the plate, cool down) are shared by its parts.

source.engine: bed_fill_height_mm (the stack of parts and the base layers)
parts_per_build (Additive - Parts per build)

fields.name: Build Setup
fields.formula: {Prepare Chamber Time} + {Fit Plate Time} + {Heat Time} + {Cool Time}

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: ({Build Time} + {Build Setup}) / {Parts per Build} * {Cycle Time Factor}

calculators.name: Additive - Material jetting
calculators.description: Material jetting (PolyJet), per part. Each layer at the machine's layer thickness is jetted by the print head in passes along the bed: as many strips as the scanning width takes to cover the nested parts' width, each crossed defaultNumPrintHeadPasses times at the machine's layer speed over the nested length. The build's preprocessing (printingPreprocessingTime) is shared by its parts.

source.engine: nested_length_mm (the bed length the nested parts take)
nested_width_mm (the bed width the nested parts take)
parts_per_build (Additive - Parts per build)

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: ({Build Time} + {Preprocessing Time}) / {Parts per Build} * {Cycle Time Factor}

calculators.name: Additive - Stereolithography
calculators.description: Stereolithography (SLA), per part. Every layer at slaStandardLayerResolution is wiped across the bed (the bed length at the machine's wiper speed) and waits the machine's layer delay; each part and its supports (slaSupportVolumeFraction of the support volume) are cured by the laser at the machine's speed and beam. The build's preprocessing (slaPreprocessingTime) is shared by its parts.

source.engine: support_volume_mm3
parts_per_build (Additive - Parts per build)

fields.name: Scan Time
fields.formula: ({Part Volume} + {Support Volume} * {Support Fraction}) / ({Scanning Speed} * {Beam Diameter} * {Layer Thickness})

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: ({Build Time} + {Preprocessing Time}) / {Parts per Build} * {Cycle Time Factor}

calculators.name: Additive - Part curing
calculators.description: Post-curing printed parts in an oven: one cure (curingMaxCureTime) per oven load, shared by the parts the oven's bed takes (Additive - Parts per build on the oven).

source.engine: parts_per_load (Additive - Parts per build, on the oven's bed)

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: {Cure Time} / max({Parts per Load}, 1) * {Cycle Time Factor}

calculators.name: Additive - Support breakoff
calculators.description: Breaking the supports off by hand: each support region is reached (handbreakoffPositioningTime) and broken off (handBreakOffTime), and its contact with the part is cleared at the process's hand breakoff rate (tblHandBreakoffRate, the row of the build process: Direct Metal Laser Sintering, Material Jetting or Stereolithography).

source.cad: overhang_area (the supports' contact with the part)

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: ({Support Regions} * ({Breakoff Time} + {Positioning Time}) + {Contact Area} / {Breakoff Rate}) * {Cycle Time Factor}

calculators.name: Additive - Manual base removal
calculators.description: Separating the part from the build plate with hand tools: its contact with the plate is cleared at the metal hand breakoff rate (tblHandBreakoffRate, Direct Metal Laser Sintering).

calculators.name: Additive - Power tool base removal
calculators.description: Cutting the part off its build plate through the support base with an oscillating power tool: the plate contact cut at the tool's cutting rate.

calculators.name: Additive - Powder loading
calculators.description: Loading the powder into the machine's chamber (dmlsPowderLoadTime), once a build, shared by its parts.

source.engine: parts_per_build

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: {Load Time} / max({Parts per Build}, 1) * {Cycle Time Factor}

calculators.name: Additive - Powder recovery
calculators.description: Recovering the unused powder after a build: vacuumed out of the machine (powderVacuumRemovalRate) and sieved back into bottles (powderSieveTimePerRun), once a build, shared by its parts.

source.engine: bed_powder_mass_kg (the bed's area times the build's height at the powder's tapped density)
parts_per_build

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: ({Bed Powder Mass} / {Vacuum Rate} * 3600 + {Sieve Time}) / max({Parts per Build}, 1) * {Cycle Time Factor}

calculators.name: Additive - Cleaning
calculators.description: Blasting the loose powder and residue off the part with compressed air: its surface at the machine's cleaning rate, never less than minCleaningTime. The export gives the rate (metalCleaningRate) without its unit; it is read as square metres a minute (unverified unit).

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: max({Minimum Time}, {Surface Area} / ({Cleaning Rate} * 1000000 / 60)) * {Cycle Time Factor}
